authoredBy: Music Stack Exchange users (human-written question titles)
labelledBy: claude-opus-5-5, from the title alone, before any router run
provenance: Fetched 2026-10-02 from https://api.stackexchange.com/2.3/questions?order=desc&sort=creation&todate=1790812800&site=music&pagesize=100 (no key; the 100 most recent questions created before 2026-10-01T00:00Z, a mechanical rule fixed before fetching). Titles are verbatim with HTML entities decoded; question bodies are not used. Created between 2026-07-10 and 2026-09-29.
license: Titles are Stack Exchange user contributions under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/), reused with attribution: each prompt's `source` names the question, its link and its author. `content_license` is null where the API omitted the field; Stack Exchange licenses posts made after 2018-05-02 under CC BY-SA 4.0.
labelRule: A skill id when one listed skill (jev/options-full.json) answers the title as asked, from the title alone. `__none__` when no listed skill covers the question's subject (notation, engraving, instruments other than guitar chord shapes, gear, software, singing, history, performance practice). `ambiguous` when a listed skill covers the subject but the title lacks an input it needs, or when two labels are defensible; ambiguous titles are routed and reported but not scored. Site tags were visible while labelling.
